entities.summary: Seyyed Mohammad Ali Ale-Hashem, also known as "Ayatollah Ale-Hashem" was an Iranian jurist and Twelver Shia cleric who was the representative of Vali-e-Faqih in the province of East Azerbaijan, and Imam of Friday Prayer in Tabriz.
